units.en: If the first enfeoffment was recent and direct-line temples existed above, the putative ancestor was moved upward while the Grand Ancestor was not destroyed.
units.literal: If the first enfeoffment was recent and direct-line temples existed above, the putative ancestor was moved upward while the Grand Ancestor was not destroyed.

units.zh: 魏祖武帝則處士迭毀，唐祖景帝 則弘農迭毀，此前世祖其始封之君，以法契、稷之明例也。
units.en: Wei ancestor Emperor Wu had the Commoner successively destroyed; Tang ancestor Emperor Jing had Hongnong successively destroyed—these former ages honored their first enfeoffed lords, following Qi and Ji's clear precedent.
units.literal: Wei ancestor Emperor Wu had the Commoner successively destroyed; Tang ancestor Emperor Jing had Hongnong successively destroyed—these former ages honored their first enfeoffed lords, following Qi and Ji's clear precedent.

units.zh: 唐韓愈有言：『事異商、周，禮從而變。』
units.en: Han Yu of Tang said that when affairs differ from Shang and Zhou, ritual changes accordingly.
units.literal: Tang's Han Yu said: 'When affairs differ from Shang and Zhou, ritual changes accordingly.'

units.zh: 晉琅邪王德文曰：『七廟之義，自由德厚流光，享祀及遠，非 是為太祖申尊祖之祀。』
units.en: Jin's Prince Dewen of Langye said that the meaning of seven temples arises from deep virtue and far-reaching radiance, sacrifice reaching the remote—not to extend Grand Ancestor worship to honor ancestors.
units.literal: Jin's Prince Dewen of Langye said: 'The meaning of seven temples arises from virtue deep and radiance far-reaching, sacrifice reaching the remote—it is not to extend Grand Ancestor worship to honor ancestors.'

units.zh: 其說是也。
units.en: This theory is correct.
units.literal: This theory is correct.

units.zh: 禮，天子七廟，而太祖之遠近不可以必，但雲三昭三穆與太祖之廟而七，未嘗言親廣之首，必為始祖也。
units.en: By ritual the Son of Heaven has seven temples, but the Grand Ancestor's remoteness cannot be fixed; ritual only says three zhao, three mu, and the Grand Ancestor's temple make seven—it never requires the head of the direct line to be founding ancestor.
units.literal: By ritual the Son of Heaven has seven temples, but the Grand Ancestor's remoteness cannot be fixed; it only says three zhao, three mu, and the Grand Ancestor's temple make seven—it never says the head of the direct line must be founding ancestor.

units.zh: 國家以僖祖親盡而祧 之，奉景祐之詔，以太祖為帝者之祖，是合於禮矣。
units.en: The state moved Xizu to distant-line status when affection was exhausted, following the Jingyou edict making Taizu the emperor's ancestor—in full accord with ritual.
units.literal: The state moved Xizu to distant-line status when affection was exhausted, following the Jingyou edict making Taizu the emperor's ancestor—this accords with ritual.

units.zh: 張昭、任徹之徒，不能遠推隆極之制，因緣近比，請建四廟，遂使天子之禮下同諸侯。
units.en: Zhang Zhao, Ren Che, and their kind could not extend the system of supreme elevation; drawing on recent comparison they requested four temples, reducing the Son of Heaven's ritual to that of feudal lords.
units.literal: Zhang Zhao, Ren Che, and their kind could not extend far the system of supreme elevation; drawing on recent comparison, they requested four temples, making the Son of Heaven's ritual the same as feudal lords.

units.zh: 若使廟數備六，則更當上 推兩世，而僖祖次在第三，亦未可謂之始祖也。
units.en: If temples reached six, one must push two generations further up, and Xizu would rank third—he still could not be called founding ancestor.
units.literal: If temple count reached six, one must push two generations further up, and Xizu would rank third—he still could not be called founding ancestor.

units.zh: 謹按建隆四年，親郊崇配不及僖祖。
units.en: We note that in 963, at the border sacrifice the elevated pairing did not reach Xizu.
units.literal: We respectfully note that in the fourth year of Jianlong, at the border sacrifice the elevated pairing did not reach Xizu.

units.zh: 開國以來，大祭虛其東向，斯乃祖宗已行之意。
units.en: Since the founding, great sacrifices have left the east-facing position vacant—the intent our ancestors already enacted.
units.literal: Since the founding, great sacrifices have left the east-facing position vacant—this is the intent our ancestors already enacted.

units.zh: 請略仿《周官》守祧之制，築別 廟以藏僖祖神主，大祭之歲，祀於其室。
units.en: We propose roughly following the Rites of Zhou's system of guarding distant-line shrines, building a separate temple for Xizu's tablet and worshiping there in years of great sacrifice.
units.literal: We request roughly following the Rites of Zhou's system of guarding distant-line shrines, building a separate temple to store Xizu's spirit tablet, and in years of great sacrifice worshiping in its chamber.

units.zh: 太廟則一依舊制，虛東向之位。
units.en: The ancestral temple should follow former regulations entirely, leaving the east-facing position vacant.
units.literal: The Imperial Ancestral Temple should follow the former regulations entirely, leaving the east-facing position vacant.

units.zh: 郊配之禮，則仍其舊。」
units.en: Border-sacrifice pairing should remain as before."
units.literal: Border-sacrifice pairing ritual should remain as before."

units.zh: 同判禮院周孟陽等言：「自僖祖而上，世次莫知，則僖祖為始祖無疑，宜以僖祖配感生帝。」
units.en: Acting head Zhou Mengyang of the Court of Ritual and others argued: "Generations above Xizu are unknown, Xizu as founding ancestor is beyond doubt, and he should be paired with the Life-Giving Emperor."
units.literal: Acting head of the Court of Ritual Zhou Mengyang and others stated: "From Xizu upward, generations are unknown—then Xizu as founding ancestor is beyond doubt; he should be paired with the Life-Giving Emperor."
